'''2007 Corellia Regionals Jacob Adams DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Adams]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Full Loss Minus Twenty
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
